title: 1 million business customers putting AI to work
summary: More than 1 million business customers around the world now use OpenAI. Across healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and more, ChatGPT and our APIs are driving a new era of intelligent, AI-powered work.
body: More than 1 million business customers around the world now use OpenAI. Across healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and more, ChatGPT and our APIs are driving a new era of intelligent, AI-powered work.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布其商业客户数量已突破100万大关，涵盖医疗、生命科学及金融服务等多个关键领域。这一数据标志着大模型技术在企业级应用中已进入规模化落地阶段，通过API集成与ChatGPT工具，企业正加速实现智能化工作流的转型，体现了AI在提升生产力方面的广泛影响力与市场渗透率。

aiReview.reasonZh: 展示了大规模企业级AI应用的里程碑，反映了当前行业采用的广度。

glossary.explanationZh: 应用程序编程接口，用于将模型能力集成到企业现有业务系统中。
企业级采用，指大型组织将AI技术整合进核心业务流程。
